description: Submit an ICE spec for an initiative FOR HUMAN REVIEW. This does not change the active spec: a person must open the initiative in the AnyForge Console, review every section, and publish it (or reject it). Until then the architect and every spec gate still see the current spec, so do not dispatch the architect expecting this spec to apply — tell the user it is awaiting their review and give them the returned reviewUrl, the absolute Console link to the review page (reviewPath is the same page as a path). A newer submission replaces a pending one. Only write what the user and the code support; flag open questions in `note` rather than inventing context or criteria. Requires `write` scope and an initiative-editing role.

acceptanceCriteria.description: ICE Expectations: testable, observable criteria (one per item). Required.

affectedRepos.description: Read-only dependency repositories ("owner/name"), not ones the work writes to.

agentSuitability.description: How suited this work is to autonomous agents.

context.description: ICE Context: facts about the system as it is today (one per item), not work to do.

edgeCases.description: The "what about when X?" cases the engineer must handle.

intent.description: ICE Intent: what is being built and why — motivation, the user pain, the success measure.

note.description: Note to the reviewer: sources used, assumptions, open questions (max 2000 characters).

name: anyforge_propose_initiative_spec
title: Propose initiative spec
